Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.mcp

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.mcp
MCP bounded context — infrastructure layer. McpServerCatalogAdapter implements the application.mcp.McpServerCatalog port by reading Spring AI's spring.ai.mcp.client.stdio.connections.* configuration at startup and caching the snapshot. FilesystemMcpUserScopeAdapter (US-08-004) and McpServerException (US-08-007) join this package once they land.
